verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server that exposes ready-made tools for web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarization search. First-party guides cover Claude desktop, n8n, Dify, Open WebUI, OpenClaw and Bedrock, and agent skills are documented for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex and others. The Answers endpoint is OpenAI-SDK compatible and the LLM Context endpoint is built for machine consumption. Missing for 10: standalone function-calling JSON schemas or a published OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), evidence of LangChain/LlamaIndex-style framework integrations, and independent hands-on corroboration of the tool integrations.
